content.text: Edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy) cannot use the default global fetch binding the SDK closes over at module init, or they need undici-compatible stubs with custom cert handling.
Allow NimbusClient options.fetch to supply any fetch-compatible function; all HTTP calls in the SDK must go through that hook, including retries and streaming helpers.
Acceptance: documented example for a custom fetch; default remains globalThis.fetch; type definitions accept typeof fetch; integration test injects a mock that records URLs.
